subject: Renewal + 50-seat expansion: MSA and order form redlines

Subject: Renewal + expansion — 24mo term + 50 seats (draft order attached)

Ben —

Thanks for the product walkthrough last week. We reviewed internally and are ready to move forward with a renewal for our current subscription plus an additional 50 seats for Platform Engineering (split billing across two business units). Key asks from procurement/legal:

- Term: we prefer a 24-month renewal (effective 7/1/2028)
- Order form: attached is the draft Helio OrderForm with seat counts and requested seat-split (60 seats for Core Eng, 50 seats for Platform Eng)
- Billing: procurement would like quarterly invoicing with PO on file; please confirm if Redwood can accept split invoicing to two POs (different cost centers)
- Data retention & audit logs: confirm that audit logs are retained for 13 months and that there is an exportable CSV for monthly compliance checks

We can run procurement redlines against your MSA — if you could loop in legal and revenue ops, we’ll aim to have a countersigned order form by June 22.

Attaching: Helio_OrderForm_v1.xlsx (Order form draft)

Thanks,
Sarah Mendez

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 11 Jun 2028 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Renewal + expansion — 24mo term + 50 seats (draft order attached)

Thanks Ben / Sarah —

I reviewed the Helio OrderForm and the MSA. I put together a short redline summary and a redlined MSA excerpt (attached: Redwood_MSA_redline_20280612.docx). High-level items:

1) Term (Section 2): propose language to extend the Agreement for a 24-month Term, effective 2028-07-01, with automatic renewal only if both parties provide 60 days' prior written notice.

2) Exhibit B / Order Form: add explicit seat allocation rows and a clause clarifying split invoicing. Proposed clause: "Customer may allocate seats across Customer entities by providing separate Purchase Orders for each cost center; Redwood will issue separate invoices per PO and prorate charges for mid-period seat increases according to the seat effective date."

3) Data retention & audit logs (Section 9): we typically retain audit logs for 12 months. For this account we can offer 13 months retention for an addendum to Exhibit E; alternatively, we can supply an automated monthly export in CSV for HelioWorks' internal retention. Recommend Helio choose which option to include in the order form.

4) Indemnity / Liability Cap (Section 7): customer requested slight relaxation for a third-party integration claim. I propose we keep our standard liability cap but add a limited carve-out for gross negligence / willful misconduct.

5) Payment terms: our standard Net 30; if Helio requires quarterly invoicing with split POs we need to confirm net due date and whether payments will be made to separate GL codes. Laura — can you confirm billing flow and whether split quarterly invoices are supported?

Next steps:
- Sarah: confirm whether Helio wants the 13-month retention or the CSV export option
- Laura: confirm billing split/proration mechanics
- Ben: if agreed, I'll prepare a clean MSA + order form ready for DocuSign and include a short summary of the redlines for procurement.

Attaching: Redwood_MSA_redline_20280612.docx (Word, redline, 28KB)

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com

Thanks for the quick review. A couple clarifications from procurement/legal at HelioWorks:

- We prefer an exported monthly CSV for audit logs (internal retention policy requires us to ingest into our compliance data lake). If Redwood can guarantee a stable CSV schema and automated delivery, that will work better than changing retention terms.
- Payment: procurement will supply two POs (one for Core Eng, one for Platform Eng). They prefer quarterly billing; Net 45 is acceptable to them. Can Redwood accept Net 45 on the invoice?
- Indemnity: procurement is okay with standard liability cap but has asked for clarity around third-party integration questions — Sarah included a short note in the attached PO.

Attaching: Helio_PO_20280613.pdf (procurement PO, 14KB)

If Redwood can confirm CSV export and Net 45 terms, we’ll mark the redline as acceptable and move to signature.
